title: Rust unsafe overlapping mutable reborrowing in zero-copy deserializer
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0183: Rust unsafe overlapping mutable reborrowing in zero-copy deserializer
Repository: `rust-lang/rust`
Category: `Memory Safety & Undefined Behavior`
Target File: `src/zerocopy/decoder.rs`

#### Problem Description
Transmute of raw byte slice into mutable reference aliases with parent container buffer under Stacked Borrows.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Replace raw transmute with MaybeUninit slice reborrow and enforce non-overlapping lifetime bounds.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0183.py -q`
expected_invariant: Replace raw transmute with MaybeUninit slice reborrow and enforce non-overlapping lifetime bounds.
